channels.name: TXp
channels.purpose: Positive line of the differential transmit pair.
channels.active_levels: AC-coupled, 0.8 V differential pp typical, 0.5 V common mode, 8b/10b encoded at 2.5 Gb/s Gen 1
channels.idle_level: Electrical Idle when LTSSM not in L0 or L0s

channels.name: TXn
channels.purpose: Negative line of the differential transmit pair.

channels.name: RXp
channels.purpose: Positive line of the differential receive pair.
channels.active_levels: AC-coupled, 0.175 V differential pp min after channel loss

channels.name: RXn
channels.purpose: Negative line of the differential receive pair.

channels.name: REFCLK+
channels.purpose: Positive line of 100 MHz reference clock differential pair; SSC-tolerant; common or separate clock topology.

channels.name: REFCLK-
channels.purpose: Negative line of 100 MHz reference clock differential pair.

channels.name: PERST#
channels.purpose: Fundamental Reset; active LOW; asserted while main power is unstable.

channels.name: WAKE#
channels.purpose: Pulled LOW by any device that wants to resume from L2 / L3.

global_signals.name: REFCLK
global_signals.purpose: 100 MHz reference clock for all components in a Common Clock domain.

global_signals.name: PERST#
global_signals.purpose: Fundamental reset distributed to every component.

global_signals.name: WAKE#
global_signals.purpose: Open-drain wakeup signal; any device can assert to wake the system from L2/L3.

handshake_pairs.name: DE-to-D
handshake_pairs.rule: Software asserts DE before clocking the first start bit into D; deasserts DE after the last stop bit + tHOLD.

handshake_pairs.name: RE#-to-R
handshake_pairs.rule: Software keeps RE# = LOW during receive windows so the host UART sees the bus.

handshake_pairs.name: Driver-arbitration
handshake_pairs.rule: Application protocol (Modbus master / token / TDM) enforces exclusive DE = HIGH on one node at a time.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Single shared differential bus; all nodes monitor V_AB simultaneously; only one driver may be enabled at a time on half-duplex.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Receiver R reflects current V_AB only when RE# = LOW; D drives V_AB only when DE = HIGH.
dependency_graph.failsafe_dependency: Idle V_AB is held > +200 mV by external R_B divider or by integrated transceiver failsafe biasing.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active TX symbol stream
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Continuously driven differential signaling carrying 8b/10b-encoded TLP / DLLP / Idle / Ordered-Set data.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Electrical Idle
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Transmitter outputs no symbol stream; differential output is undriven (or held at common mode).

logical_signaling_levels.name: Beacon
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: 30 kHz to 500 MHz modulated pulses on the differential pair used to wake the Link from L2 when REFCLK is off.

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: Byte is 8b/10b-encoded then transmitted LSB of the 10-bit symbol first on the wire (per Figure 4-3, Bit Transmission Order on Physical Lanes).
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_field: Little-endian for multi-byte fields within TLP headers (matches PCI convention).
ordering_rules.lane_striping: Multi-Lane Links stripe successive bytes round-robin starting at Lane 0; STP/SDP MUST land on Lane 0.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Dual-simplex: TX and RX directions transmit independently and simultaneously.

channels_bus_side_2_wire.name: A (non-inverting)
channels_bus_side_2_wire.purpose: Non-inverting differential bus line; when transmitting mark, A is the more positive line of the pair.
channels_bus_side_2_wire.active_levels: V_A - V_B > +200 mV at receiver → mark; V_A - V_B < -200 mV → space

channels_bus_side_2_wire.name: B (inverting)
channels_bus_side_2_wire.purpose: Inverting differential bus line; complementary to A.

channels_host_side.name: D / DI
channels_host_side.purpose: Driver input from host UART TX; logic level.

channels_host_side.name: DE
channels_host_side.purpose: Driver Enable (active HIGH); when LOW, driver tri-stated.

channels_host_side.name: RE# (RE)
channels_host_side.purpose: Receiver Enable (active LOW); when HIGH, receiver output tri-stated.

channels_host_side.name: R / RO
channels_host_side.purpose: Receiver output to host UART RX; logic level.

logical_signal_states.name: loss-of-signal (LOS)
logical_signal_states.value: |V_AB| < 200 mV; receiver R indeterminate unless failsafe-biased

bus_field_segments.name: IDLE_BIASED
bus_field_segments.form: Driver tri-stated; failsafe holds V_AB > +200 mV

bus_field_segments.name: DE_GUARD_BAND
bus_field_segments.form: Software-controlled blank time between DE deassert and DE reassert
